filters.semantic_query: Named test chemicals were evaluated for mechanistic skin sensitization using peptide or protein reactivity and covalent haptenation, DPRA, KeratinoSens or ARE-Nrf2 activation, dendritic-cell activation in h-CLAT or GARD, cytokine biomarkers, or another adverse-outcome-pathway key-event assay, with chemical-level assay outcomes reported.

A named test chemical was incubated with cysteine, lysine, glutathione, a model peptide, or a skin protein, and peptide depletion, thiol loss, covalent adduct formation, reaction kinetics, or a DPRA-related classification was reported as mechanistic evidence of skin sensitization.

Named test chemicals were applied to THP-1 cells in the h-CLAT or a related dendritic-cell activation assay, and CD86 or CD54 relative fluorescence intensity, EC150, EC200, minimum induction threshold, cell viability, cytokine response, or sensitizer classification was reported.
